job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Saviynt IGA Professional with Industry experience in design, development, customization, configuration, deployment of Saviynt Identity Management and Governance.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and implement end-to-end lifecycle management processes for human and non-human identities using Saviynt.
Advanced debugging and troubleshooting issues, including interacting with technology vendors
Involve in requirements gathering, design documentation
Implement, configure, and maintain Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions.
Integrate Saviynt with various systems (e.g., Active Directory, DB, Rest etc.).
Design and develop workflows, connectors, and access request processes within Saviynt.
Configure Access reviews, and certification campaigns in Saviynt. Familiar with User manager, entitlement owner, application owner campaigns
Collaborate with security, compliance, and IT teams to define IAM policies and controls.
Develop and maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and procedures.

Skill Requirements:

B.Tech/M.Tech/MS
Experience 3 to 8 years.
Candidate should have minimum 3+ years experience of hands-on IAM experience in Saviynt.
Good understanding of Identity and Access Management, Single Sign On (SSO) and IT Security concepts.
Experience in implementing IAM engagements, including requirements gathering, analysis, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and application support.
Experience in user Joiner, leaver and Mover process and design the policies.
Experience in technologies such as Java, LDAP, SSL RDBMS, and Linux
Experience in development/configuration of standard/custom IAM integrations using Java, .Net, or other major scripting languages
Excellent verbal and written communication
Preferred:
Saviynt L100 and L200 certifications

Who We are...

SmarTek21, founded in 2006, is an innovative digital transformation leader dedicated to empowering organizations through design-led, data-centric solutions. We believe that exceptional user experiences and intelligent data-driven insights are pivotal in shaping the future of business. At the heart of our approach is Design-Led Engineering, where we combine strategic design principles with cutting-edge technology to create tailored solutions that deliver significant business outcomes. Our commitment to accelerating digital transformation includes specialized expertise in Agile DevOps, Data Engineering and analytics, Testing Automation and support, and comprehensive Managed Application and Infrastructure Services. We ve evolved from our consulting and development roots into a full-spectrum service provider, integrating advanced technologies like Generative AI (GenAI) to facilitate our clients seamless, transformative digital journeys. A passion unites our dynamic team of technology visionaries and business strategists for innovation and excellence. At SmarTek21, youll join a collaborative environment dedicated to shaping the digital landscape and driving impactful results for organizations worldwide.

SmarTek21 is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.
